post_reading_explanation: Docked probe GPU use is 17-34 percent (steady 26-34) from about 3.6 s after start to the end; sampler reads 0 from the first sample after exit (237.8) while quiet2's first sample, taken at about the same instant, read 36 (above every in-run value). All 4 docked post readings failed on sample 1 only; all non-docked ones passed on GPU; the next two samples were 0. Best explanation: the probe's own GPU activity, either an exit/teardown burst or the counter lagging by under a second; not a second user. The sampler narrows it but does not prove which.
